test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

I am not the most wisest person here to teach you this lesson.

options.text: I am not the most wisest

solution:
The erroneous part is: **I am not the most wisest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the use of double superlatives 'most' and 'wisest' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be either **'the wisest'** or **'the most wise'**, but not both.
 
• Therefore, the corrected sentence should be 'I am not the wisest person here to teach you this lesson.'.

Correct sentence: *I am not the **wisest person** here to teach you this lesson.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In English grammar, using two superlatives together is considered incorrect. Only one superlative should be used to describe the highest degree of a quality.
 
 
• **Example:** *She is the most talented singer.* (correct)
 
• **Example:** *She is the most talentedest singer.* (incorrect)
